en.title: Home
en.description: A four-star boutique hotel at Ćumurija 8, steps from Baščaršija and the Sacred Heart Cathedral. 32 rooms and suites, a 25 m heated pool, a day spa and Central Café.

settings.editor:
A distinctive stay in the heart of Sarajevo.

Traditional Irish hospitality and Bosnian charm, steps from Baščaršija and the Sacred Heart Cathedral.
Contemporary comfort and timeless hospitality in Sarajevo's historic center.
Thirty-two rooms and suites, each designed for a restful stay, with quality beds, modern amenities and calm, elegant interiors. Start your day with a breakfast buffet and Bosnian coffee.
Room size 15 m²
Room size 26 m²
Room size 26 m²
Room size 50 m²
Room size 37 m²
Apartment size 53 m²
Two places of their own inside the hotel: a fitness club with a 25-metre pool, and a quiet day spa.
A gym over three floors, a heated 25 m pool, sauna, steam room and group classes.
Massage, facials, the Iyashi Dome and balneo bath, with prices and online booking.

Coffee, tea and hot chocolate, fresh juices, smoothies and something sweet, by the tall windows of Central Café on Ćumurija street.

For our guests and for corporate events, catering is available on request.

The conference room is located on the first floor, in a new and separate part of our premises, which guarantees peace and privacy. It is fully equipped with all necessary IT equipment, and the setup changes with the number of participants and the type of event.

Nestled in the heart of Old Town Sarajevo, just steps away from historic landmarks such as the Old Bazaar and Baščaršija Square. Almost all sights are within walking distance — the best way to stumble upon something interesting along the way.

bs.title: Početna
bs.description: Hotel sa četiri zvjezdice na adresi Ćumurija 8, na nekoliko koraka od Baščaršije i Katedrale. 32 sobe i apartmana, grijani bazen od 25 m, day spa i Central Café.

settings.editor:
Poseban boravak u srcu Sarajeva.

Tradicionalno irsko gostoprimstvo i bosanski šarm, na nekoliko koraka od Baščaršije i Katedrale.
Savremena udobnost i bezvremensko gostoprimstvo u historijskom centru Sarajeva.

Trideset i dvije sobe i apartmana, svaki uređen za miran boravak, s kvalitetnim krevetima, modernim sadržajima i smirenim, elegantnim enterijerom. Započnite dan doručkom na bazi švedskog stola i bosanskom kafom.

Dva posebna mjesta u hotelu: fitness klub s bazenom od 25 metara i mirni day spa.
Teretana na tri sprata, grijani bazen od 25 m, sauna, parno kupatilo i grupni časovi.
Masaže, tretmani lica, Iyashi Dome i balneo kupka, s cijenama i online rezervacijom.

Kafa, čaj i topla čokolada, svježi sokovi, smoothieji i nešto slatko, uz visoke prozore Central Caféa na Ćumuriji.

Za naše goste i poslovne događaje ketering je dostupan na upit.

Konferencijska sala smještena je na prvom spratu, u dijelu odvojenom od smještajnih jedinica, što garantira mir i privatnost. U potpunosti je opremljena potrebnom informatičkom opremom, a postava se mijenja ovisno o broju sudionika i vrsti događaja.

Smješten u srcu Starog grada Sarajeva, na samo nekoliko koraka od historijskih znamenitosti kao što su Baščaršija i sarajevska Katedrala. Skoro sve znamenitosti su u blizini i do njih se može doći šetnjom — najbolji način da „naletite“ na nešto interesantno.

en.title: About
en.description: A four-star, Irish-owned hotel in the heart of Old Town Sarajevo, blending traditional Irish hospitality with Bosnian charm.

settings.editor: Experience the charm of Old Town Sarajevo at our four-star, Irish-owned hotel.

Nestled in the heart of Old Town Sarajevo, Hotel Central blends traditional Irish hospitality with Bosnian charm to offer you a truly unique stay. Located just steps away from historic landmarks such as the Old Bazaar and Baščaršija Square, Hotel Central provides the perfect base for exploring the rich culture and history of Sarajevo.

Whether you're visiting Sarajevo for business or pleasure, Hotel Central offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and hospitality.

Category
Four stars
Rooms
32 rooms and suites
Capacity
65–70 guests
Address
Ćumurija 8, 71000 Sarajevo

Our 32 rooms and suites are designed with your comfort in mind, with modern amenities, quality beds and stylish decor.

Start your day with a breakfast buffet and Bosnian coffee.

Unwind and relax in our sauna, steam room and 25 m pool as well as our state of the art fitness center spread over three floors.

Our friendly and attentive staff are always on hand to ensure you have a memorable stay.

tabs.tab_title: Where is Hotel Central Sarajevo located?
tabs.tab_content: Hotel Central is located in the heart of Sarajevo, just a short walk from the historic Old Town (Baščaršija), shopping streets, restaurants and major attractions.

tabs.tab_title: Does Hotel Central offer parking?
tabs.tab_content: The hotel does not have private parking facilities. However, several public and commercial parking options are available nearby, and our reception team can provide guidance.

tabs.tab_title: What time are check-in and check-out?
tabs.tab_content: Check-in is from 15:00 and check-out is until 11:00. Early check-in or late check-out may be available upon request, subject to availability.

tabs.tab_title: Is breakfast included in my stay?
tabs.tab_content: Buffet style breakfast, with a selection of both hot and cold dishes is included with all hotel stays and runs from 07:00 until 10:00 each morning

tabs.tab_title: Does Hotel Central offer free Wi-Fi?
tabs.tab_content: Yes, complimentary Wi-Fi is available to hotel guests.

tabs.tab_title: Does Hotel Central have a gym and swimming pool?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. Central Fitness Club features an extensive range of fitness equipment, a 25-metre indoor swimming pool and additional wellness facilities.

tabs.tab_title: Can non-hotel guests use Central Fitness Club?
tabs.tab_content: Absolutely! Central Fitness Club operates as a standalone fitness facility, offering membership options to the public as well as access for hotel guests.

tabs.tab_title: Is access to Central Fitness Club included with my hotel stay?
tabs.tab_content: Access to our fitness and wet area facilities is included with all stays at Hotel Central. During your stay, feel free to make use of our full fitness facilities, including our 25m swimming pool, sauna and steam rooms!

tabs.tab_title: Does Hotel Central have a spa?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. Our dedicated Day Spa offers a range of professional massage, beauty and wellness treatments in a relaxing environment.

tabs.tab_title: Can I book a spa treatment without staying at the hotel?
tabs.tab_content:
Yes absolutely! Central Day Spa is open to the public and hotel guests from Tuesday to Saturday from 11:00 until 20:00. Advance reservations are recommended to secure your preferred treatment and appointment time.

Also, with every treatment booked, you can use our pool and thermal facilities for up to 2 hours at no extra cost.

tabs.tab_title: How can I book a spa treatment?
tabs.tab_content: You can contact our Day Spa team directly on +387 33 561 830 or at dayspa@hotelcentral.ba, or enquire through hotel reception for treatment information, availability and reservations.

tabs.tab_title: Does Hotel Central have a café?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. Central Café offers quality coffee, tea, cold beverages and a selection of cakes and sweet treats in a welcoming city-centre setting.

tabs.tab_title: Does Hotel Central offer conference or meeting facilities?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. We provide meeting and conference facilities suitable for corporate gatherings, presentations and professional events. Contact our team for availability and arrangements.

tabs.tab_title: How far is Hotel Central from Sarajevo International Airport?
tabs.tab_content: The hotel is approximately 10–12 km from Sarajevo International Airport. Approximately 20-25 minutes by car, but travel times may vary depending on traffic conditions.

tabs.tab_title: How can I contact Hotel Central to get more information or make a booking?
tabs.tab_content: You can reach our reception team by telephone at +387 33 561 800, by email at info@hotelcentral.ba, and we’ll be happy to answer any additional questions you might have! You can also book directly on our website.

settings.editor: Book directly with Hotel Central through our secure reservation system.

bs.title: O nama
bs.description: Hotel sa četiri zvjezdice u vlasništvu irske kompanije, u srcu Starog grada Sarajeva — irsko gostoprimstvo i bosanski šarm.

settings.editor: Doživite potpuni šarm Starog grada Sarajeva u našem hotelu sa četiri zvjezdice, koji je u vlasništvu irske kompanije.

Smješten u srcu Starog grada Sarajeva, Hotel Central spaja tradicionalno irsko gostoprimstvo sa bosanskim šarmom, nudeći vam zaista jedinstven boravak. Nalazi se na samo nekoliko koraka od historijskih znamenitosti kao što su Stari dio grada, Baščaršijski trg i sarajevska Katedrala, čineći ga savršenom polaznom tačkom za istraživanje bogate kulture i historije Sarajeva.

Bilo da posjećujete Sarajevo zbog posla ili zadovoljstva, Hotel Central nudi savršen spoj udobnosti i gostoprimstva.

Kategorija
Četiri zvjezdice
Sobe
32 sobe i apartmana
Kapacitet
65–70 osoba
Adresa
Ćumurija 8, 71000 Sarajevo

Naše 32 sobe i apartmana uređeni su s mišlju na vašu udobnost, s modernim sadržajima, kvalitetnim krevetima i elegantnim enterijerom.

Započnite dan doručkom na bazi švedskog stola i bosanskom kafom.

Opustite se u našoj finskoj sauni, parnoj kupelji i bazenu od 25 metara, kao i u vrhunskom fitnes centru koji se prostire na tri etaže.

Ljubazno i pažljivo osoblje našeg hotela uvijek je pri ruci kako bi vam osiguralo nezaboravan boravak.

tabs.tab_title: Gdje se nalazi Hotel Central Sarajevo?
tabs.tab_content: Hotel Central smješten je u samom srcu Sarajeva, na svega nekoliko minuta hoda od historijske jezgre grada (Baščaršije), trgovačkih ulica, restorana i glavnih turističkih atrakcija.

tabs.tab_title: Da li Hotel Central ima parking?
tabs.tab_content: Hotel ne raspolaže vlastitim parkingom. Međutim, u neposrednoj blizini dostupno je nekoliko javnih i komercijalnih parkinga, a naše osoblje na recepciji rado će vam pružiti dodatne informacije.

tabs.tab_title: U koliko sati je prijava i odjava iz hotela?
tabs.tab_content: Prijava u hotel (check-in) moguća je od 15:00 sati, a odjava (check-out) do 11:00 sati. Ranija prijava ili kasnija odjava mogu biti omogućene na zahtjev, u zavisnosti od raspoloživosti.

tabs.tab_title: Da li je doručak uključen u cijenu smještaja?
tabs.tab_content: Da, doručak na bazi švedskog stola uključen je u cijenu svakog boravka u hotelu. Gostima je na raspolaganju raznovrstan izbor toplih i hladnih jela, a doručak se poslužuje svakog jutra od 07:00 do 10:00 sati.

tabs.tab_title: Da li Hotel Central nudi besplatan Wi-Fi?
tabs.tab_content: Da, svim gostima hotela dostupan je besplatan bežični internet (Wi-Fi).

tabs.tab_title: Da li Hotel Central ima teretanu i bazen?
tabs.tab_content: Da. Central Fitness Club nudi širok izbor savremene fitness opreme, zatvoreni bazen dužine 25 metara i dodatne wellness sadržaje.

tabs.tab_title: Mogu li Central Fitness Club koristiti osobe koje nisu gosti hotela?
tabs.tab_content: Naravno! Central Fitness Club posluje i kao samostalni fitness centar, nudeći različite mogućnosti članstva za vanjske korisnike, kao i pristup gostima hotela.

tabs.tab_title: Da li je korištenje Central Fitness Cluba uključeno u cijenu boravka u hotelu?
tabs.tab_content: Da, korištenje fitness i wellness sadržaja uključeno je u cijenu svakog boravka u Hotelu Central. Tokom boravka možete besplatno koristiti našu kompletno opremljenu teretanu, zatvoreni bazen dužine 25 metara, saunu i parna kupatila.

tabs.tab_title: Da li Hotel Central ima spa centar?
tabs.tab_content: Da. Naš Day Spa nudi raznovrsne profesionalne masaže, kozmetičke i wellness tretmane u ugodnom i opuštajućem ambijentu.

tabs.tab_title: Mogu li rezervisati spa tretman ako nisam gost hotela?
tabs.tab_content:
Naravno! Central Day Spa otvoren je za sve posjetioce, kao i za goste hotela, od utorka do subote, u periodu od 11:00 do 20:00 sati. Preporučujemo rezervaciju unaprijed kako biste osigurali željeni tretman i termin.

Također, uz svaki rezervisani tretman, možete koristiti naš bazen i termalne sadržaje do 2 sata bez dodatnih troškova.

tabs.tab_title: Kako mogu rezervisati spa tretman?
tabs.tab_content: Za informacije o tretmanima, slobodnim terminima i rezervacijama možete direktno kontaktirati naš Day Spa tim (+387 33 561 830, dayspa@hotelcentral.ba) ili se obratiti recepciji hotela.

tabs.tab_title: Da li Hotel Central ima kafić?
tabs.tab_content: Da. Central Café nudi kvalitetnu kafu, čajeve, hladne napitke te izbor kolača i slatkih poslastica u ugodnom ambijentu u samom centru Sarajeva.

tabs.tab_title: Da li Hotel Central nudi prostor za konferencije i poslovne sastanke?
tabs.tab_content: Da. Hotel raspolaže prostorom za sastanke i konferencije, pogodnim za poslovna okupljanja, prezentacije i profesionalne događaje. Kontaktirajte naš tim za više informacija o raspoloživosti i organizaciji.

tabs.tab_title: Koliko je Hotel Central udaljen od Međunarodnog aerodroma Sarajevo?
tabs.tab_content: Hotel je udaljen približno 10–12 km od Međunarodnog aerodroma Sarajevo. Vožnja automobilom obično traje oko 20–25 minuta, u zavisnosti od saobraćajnih uslova.

tabs.tab_title: Kako mogu kontaktirati Hotel Central za dodatne informacije ili rezervaciju?
tabs.tab_content:
Našu recepciju možete kontaktirati telefonom na broj +387 33 561 800 ili putem e-maila na info@hotelcentral.ba. Naš tim rado će odgovoriti na sva vaša dodatna pitanja!

Rezervaciju smještaja možete izvršiti i direktno putem naše web stranice.

en.title: Central Café
en.description: Central Café at Hotel Central Sarajevo: coffee, tea, hot chocolate, cold drinks, fresh juices, smoothies and sweet treats, with catering for guests and corporate events on request.

settings.editor: Meet a friend, read the paper by the tall arched windows or take a break between meetings. The café is open to hotel guests and to everyone passing by on Ćumurija street.

icon_list.text: Hot drinks: coffee (including Bosnian coffee), tea and hot chocolate
Fresh juices from our juice bar

settings.editor:
We don't run a restaurant, but we are happy to cater for our hotel guests and for corporate events on request: coffee breaks, refreshments and catered lunches for meetings, seminars and celebrations.

Tell us the date, the number of guests and what you need, and we will prepare a proposal for you.
Book directly with Hotel Central through our secure reservation system.

bs.title: Central Café
bs.description: Central Café u Hotelu Central Sarajevo: kafa, čaj i topla čokolada, hladni napici, svježi sokovi, smoothieji i slatke poslastice na Ćumuriji, uz ketering za goste i poslovne događaje na upit.

settings.editor: Sretnite se s prijateljem, pročitajte novine uz visoke lučne prozore ili napravite pauzu između sastanaka. Kafić je otvoren za goste hotela i za sve prolaznike u Ćumuriji.

icon_list.text: Topli napici: kafa (uključujući bosansku kafu), čaj i topla čokolada
Svježi sokovi iz našeg juice bara

settings.editor:
Nemamo restoran, ali na upit rado pripremamo ketering za naše goste i za poslovne događaje: pauze za kafu, osvježenje i ručak za sastanke, seminare i proslave.

Javite nam datum, broj gostiju i šta vam je potrebno, a mi ćemo vam pripremiti ponudu.
Rezervišite direktno kod Hotela Central putem našeg sigurnog sistema za rezervacije.

en.title: Rooms & Suites
en.description: Six categories of rooms and suites at Hotel Central Sarajevo, from the single room to the presidential suite with terrace.

settings.editor: Six room categories, from the single room to the presidential suite with its terrace.
An air-conditioned room with a high large bed (200×140 cm), writing desk and free Wi-Fi. Upgrade available upon request.
Room with a flat-screen & cable TV, tea and coffee making facilities, a safe and a spacious bathroom.
Carefully equipped and decorated with well chosen materials and colours, with comfortable armchairs and sofas.
More than 50 square meters in the modern, newly built part of the hotel — two high double beds or four single beds.
Spacious suite with a flat-screen cable TV, a seating area, tea and coffee making facilities and a spacious bathroom.

en.title: Location
en.description: Hotel Central is at Ćumurija 8 in the centre of Sarajevo, near the Sacred Heart Cathedral, the Latin Bridge and Baščaršija.

settings.editor: Sarajevo suits the walker. We're in the city centre and almost all sights are within walking distance.
Sarajevo International Airport is approx. 10–12 km away, about 20–25 minutes by car depending on traffic. A taxi can be booked through our reception; fares are approximate and may vary.
Ask for the Hotel Central stop at the Latin Bridge or the Sacred Heart Cathedral. The coach runs daily according to flight times; fares and timetables are on centrotrans.com and may change.
Bus stops beside the hotel serve the centre and its surroundings. Tram no. 3 runs between Ilidža and Baščaršija (Old Town). Ticket prices may vary.
The Centrotrans sightseeing bus stops about 50 m from the hotel. Tours usually run in the summer season; please check times with reception.
Enter “Hotel Central, Ćumurija 8, Sarajevo” as your destination. The hotel has no private parking, but several public and commercial car parks are nearby; reception will help you.

Sarajevo suits the walker. We're in the city centre and almost all sights are within walking distance.

It's the best way to stumble upon something interesting along the way.

bs.title: Lokacija
bs.description: Hotel Central se nalazi na adresi Ćumurija 8, u centru Sarajeva, u blizini Katedrale, Latinske ćuprije i Baščaršije.

settings.editor: Sarajevo je pogodno za šetanje. Nalazimo se u srcu grada i skoro sve znamenitosti su u blizini.
Međunarodni aerodrom Sarajevo udaljen je približno 10–12 km, oko 20–25 minuta vožnje, zavisno od saobraćaja. Taksi možete naručiti preko recepcije; cijene su okvirne i mogu se razlikovati.
Tražite stanicu kod Latinske ćuprije ili Katedrale. Autobus vozi svakodnevno prema redu letenja; cijene i red vožnje su na centrotrans.com i mogu se mijenjati.
Autobuske stanice pored hotela povezuju centar i okolinu. Tramvaj broj 3 vozi od Ilidže do Baščaršije. Cijene karata mogu se razlikovati.
Centrotransov turistički autobus staje oko 50 m od hotela. Ture obično voze u ljetnoj sezoni; vrijeme provjerite na recepciji.
Kao odredište unesite „Hotel Central, Ćumurija 8, Sarajevo“. Hotel nema vlastiti parking, ali u blizini je nekoliko javnih i komercijalnih parkinga; recepcija će vam pomoći.

Sarajevo je grad za šetnju. Nalazimo se u centru i skoro sve znamenitosti su na pješačkoj udaljenosti.

To je i najbolji način da „naletite“ na nešto interesantno.

en.title: Privacy policy
en.description: How Hotel Central Sarajevo handles personal data.

settings.editor:
Who we are. Hotel Central Sarajevo, Ćumurija 8, 71000 Sarajevo, Bosnia and Herzegovina. E-mail: info@hotelcentral.ba, telephone +387 33 561 800.

What this website collects. The website has no contact form and no user accounts for guests. When you write to us by e-mail or call us, we use your details only to answer you and to handle your booking.

Bookings. Room bookings are made in the secure booking system of our provider eZee (letsbook.me), and spa bookings in Lime Booking. Their own privacy terms apply to the data you enter there.

Embedded content. The map on our pages is provided by Google Maps; Google may set cookies when the map loads. Links to Facebook and Instagram open those services.

Your rights. You can ask us which personal data we hold about you, and ask us to correct or delete it, by writing to info@hotelcentral.ba.

en.title: Classes & timetable
en.description: The weekly group class timetable at Central Fitness Club, Hotel Central Sarajevo, and what each class is: functional strength, HIIT, Tabata, pilates, yoga, aqua aerobic, kettlebells and more.

settings.editor: Group classes in the studio and in the pool, every day of the week. Places are limited, so come a few minutes early.
See this week's classes and book your place online, or call the club.
When the timetable changes, edit the days below in Elementor (one line per class: time, class, duration).
What to expect from each class. The timetable can change, so check with reception or the club's Instagram.
A strength-based workout built on functional movements to improve stability, coordination and everyday strength.
High-intensity interval training with short rest periods to boost fitness and burn calories fast.
An intense lower-body workout targeting glute activation and strength. Designed for shaping, power and muscle connection.
A structured interval workout using short bursts (20 s work / 10 s rest). Fast, efficient and challenging.
Inspired by yoga and Pilates, focused on flexibility, stability and posture.
A focused session targeting core strength, stability and control. Perfect as a complement to other workouts.
A low-impact water workout. Gentle on joints while improving fitness and calorie burn.
A circuit-style workout combining strength and cardio for maximum results in minimal time. High intensity, full-body.
A calming blend of stretching, breathing and strength to improve flexibility, balance and focus.
A kettlebell-based workout combining strength, power and coordination for full-body activation.
A fast-paced workout designed to tone and define. A mix of strength and controlled movements for a lean, strong look.

bs.title: Časovi i raspored
bs.description: Sedmični raspored grupnih časova u Central Fitness Clubu, Hotel Central Sarajevo, i opis svakog časa: functional strength, HIIT, Tabata, pilates, yoga, aqua aerobik, kettlebells i drugi.

settings.editor: Grupni časovi u sali i u bazenu, svaki dan u sedmici. Broj mjesta je ograničen, pa dođite nekoliko minuta ranije.
Pogledajte časove ove sedmice i rezervišite mjesto online ili pozovite klub.
Kada se raspored promijeni, uredite dane ispod u Elementoru (jedan red po času: vrijeme, čas, trajanje).
Šta vas očekuje na svakom času. Raspored se može promijeniti, pa ga provjerite na recepciji ili na Instagramu kluba.
Trening snage baziran na funkcionalnim pokretima koji poboljšavaju stabilnost, koordinaciju i svakodnevnu snagu tijela.
Visoko intenzivan intervalni trening sa kratkim pauzama za brzo sagorijevanje kalorija i poboljšanje kondicije.
Intenzivan trening fokusiran na aktivaciju i jačanje gluteusa. Cilj je oblikovanje, snaga i bolja konekcija mišića.
Intervalni trening u kratkim, intenzivnim blokovima (20 s rad / 10 s pauza). Brz, efikasan i izazovan.
Inspirisan jogom i pilatesom, fokusiran na fleksibilnost, stabilnost i držanje tijela.
Fokusirani trening za jačanje core-a, stabilnost i kontrolu pokreta. Idealan kao dodatak drugim treninzima.
Nježan, ali efikasan trening u vodi. Idealan za zglobove, kondiciju i sagorijevanje kalorija.
Kružni trening koji kombinuje snagu i kardio za maksimalne rezultate u kratkom vremenu. Visok intenzitet, cijelo tijelo.
Kombinacija istezanja, disanja i snage za fleksibilnost, balans i mentalni fokus.
Trening sa girjama koji kombinuje snagu, eksplozivnost i koordinaciju za aktivaciju cijelog tijela.
Brzi trening za tonus i definiciju. Kombinacija snage i kontrolisanih pokreta za izdužen i snažan izgled.
